details:
This update for cups-filters fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-64611: user who controls an IEEE-1284 device ID consumed by `cfIEEE1284GetMakeModel` can drive
  `cfIEEE1284NormalizeMakeModel` into an infinite loop (bsc#1273145).
- CVE-2026-64612: authenticated client that can submit an image print job can abort the CUPS filter process by supplying
  a malformed PNG (bsc#1273146).

package.name: cups-filters
package.ecosystem: SUSE:Linux Enterprise Module for Basesystem 15 SP7
